rule: Water moves bodies: its skills shove and drag, and a shoved body that meets a wall, stone or another body is Crushed; every Crush you cause shores you up with a 15 Ward (up to 60, for 6 s).

new_mechanics.name: ward
new_mechanics.definition: One shared player state with holy.json (Dawnward, which defines it in full) and unholy.json: a pool on the player taken before health (after armour and tempering, before talents), filled by 'ward' keys up to ward_cap 60 per body; each amount keeps its own timer and the oldest is spent first. Water only fills it (crush_ward); Ice Shell's old 'absorb' is a ward with an 'on_break'.

new_mechanics.name: crush_ward
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity key {per_crush, cap, lasts}: each Crush the caster causes adds per_crush Ward, never above cap from this source, each lasting 'lasts' s. Water: 15 / 60 / 6 s.

skills.name: Breaker
skills.summary: A wide, heavy blow (2.4x strike damage, 30 poise) that throws everyone it hits 4 m away from you. Stand so the wall is behind them.
skills.verb_fit: Surge is "push bodies away": every enemy in the arc is thrown 4 m away from you. As the bruiser's close starter it hits harder before it throws (2.4x, was 2.0x).

good_modifiers.word: Drenching Breaker: everyone hit is Soaked as they go, so the same blow throws them half as far again
Rolling Breaker: a wider arc that also hammers poise
Heaving Breaker: they are thrown 2 m farther - into the wall at the back of the room
Choking Breaker: everyone thrown is interrupted and Dazed as they fly
Wide Breaker: a broader, longer arc for crowds, at a little less damage

bad_modifiers.why: a pull added to a 4 m throw: the blow drags in and throws out at once. Maths lets it act; it should not
Drain's pull on a throw: the same contradiction as Ebb, with a reflux cut as consolation
nothing lasts and nothing lands on you; falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: damage_mult 2.0 -> 2.4, +30 poise, recovery made explicit (0.35); the bruiser's bands.

skills.name: Cataract
skills.summary: Hold to gather the weight of falling water over your fists (up to 1.2 s; you are Braced and walk at 30%), then bring it down: everything within 3 m takes 1.4x to 3.0x strike damage by the charge, is Soaked, loses 60 poise and is thrown 3 m outward. One already against a wall or stone takes half again and is Crushed where it stands.
skills.verb_fit: Surge is "push bodies away": the slam throws everything around you outward, every way at once. Water's heavy hit: the weight is the point, the throw is the verb.

new_mechanics.name: against_wall_mult
new_mechanics.definition: A hit on a target already within 0.5 m of a wall, stone or another body does this much more and counts as a Crush (Water's rule, ward included) though the body does not move. Generalises Pressure Jet's pinned_mult.

good_modifiers.word: Long Cataract: held longer, it lands harder
Heaving Cataract: they are thrown 2 m farther
Choking Cataract: everything under it is interrupted and Dazed
Wide Cataract: a 4 m ring, a little lighter

bad_modifiers.why: drags in what the slam throws out: pull 1.5 against shove 3. Maths lets it act; it should not
let go at once on a skill whose whole point is the charge: a weaker slam sooner; falls back to a little power
a slam has nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Riptide Lash
skills.summary: One enemy within 10 m is hauled to arm's length, takes 60, is Soaked and interrupted - and arrives with its back to you for a second. Water's ranged starter: the bruiser does not shoot the runner, it hauls it in.
skills.verb_fit: Ebb is "draw bodies in": a rope of water that hauls a single enemy in. It is the ranged starter because a bruiser's reach is a pull (ROLES-BRIEF: a tank's ranged starter can be a pull).

good_modifiers.word: Choking Lash: it arrives Dazed as well as interrupted - take +50% for 3 s
Soaked Lash: it arrives wet through, ready to be thrown half as far again
Long Lash: a longer rope for the archer at the back
Single Lash: the one body takes more from the yank

bad_modifiers.why: shove 1.5 on a body you are hauling in: it lands a step short of you, which undoes the skill. Maths lets it act
a rolling wall on a single rope: reach and poise, but a wall that hauls one body is no wall; falls back
a yank has nothing that lasts; falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: now the ranged starter (was Water Bolt, dropped); recovery made explicit.

skills.name: Standing Pool
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a pool 3.5 m across for 8 s. Enemies in it are Soaked and 30% slower, and a shove that starts in it goes twice as far. No damage.
skills.verb_fit: Flood is "fill an area with water": a pool that stays and turns the ground wet. It serves the role by doubling every shove that starts in it: the bruiser's floor for Crushes.

good_modifiers.word: Whirlpool: every half second the pool drags those in it toward its middle
Lasting Pool: it stays half as long again
Wide Pool: a larger pool
Silting Pool: those in it stick deeper; Mired harder

bad_modifiers.why: a throw on a payload that repeats every half second: everyone in the pool is tossed about every tick. Maths lets it act; it should not
a pool deals no damage for 'through' to carry; falls back to a cost cut
maths lets it through, but on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier

skills.name: Drawdown
skills.summary: Every Soaked enemy within 8 m has the water torn out of it toward you: its Soak ends and it is dragged 3 m toward you. You get 2 essence back for each. Your Standing Pool in range empties toward you too, dragging those in it twice as far, and is gone.
skills.verb_fit: Drain is "empty the water from an area or a target, and draw it in": it empties every Soak and pool in reach and the water comes to you, bringing the bodies with it.

good_modifiers.word: Deep Drawdown: drags them farther
Silting Drawdown: they land at your feet Mired
Wide Drawdown: reaches Soaked enemies farther off
Choking Drawdown: everything drained is interrupted and Dazed as it comes

bad_modifiers.why: shoves the drained bodies away while the water drags them in. Maths lets it act; it should not
nothing to pierce; falls back to a cost cut
it is one pull, nothing lasts; falls back to a cost cut

skills.change_note: recovery made explicit for ascension; otherwise as drafted.

skills.name: Drench
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: a cloudburst gathers for 0.6 s, then falls on a 3 m circle. Everyone under it is Waterlogged for 6 s and interrupted. A Waterlogged heavy enemy is shoved as if it were light, and an elite as if it were heavy.
skills.verb_fit: Soak is "saturate a target": this soaks them through until the water is doing the work of moving them. It serves the role by making heavy enemies throwable.

good_modifiers.word: Beating Rain: the downpour also flattens them outward from the middle
Wide Drench: a bigger cloud
Sudden Drench: falls sooner, harder to step out of
Mudding Drench: Mired as well

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: wrings out the water it pours in; the bonus vs Soaked has no damage to add to. Maths lets it act; it undoes the skill
a cloudburst deals no damage for 'through' to carry; falls back to a cost cut
a cloudburst over a spot, not over you; falls back to a cost cut

skills.name: Wringing Grip
skills.summary: One enemy within reach: you grip it and wring the water out. A 2.0x blow, +100 if it was Soaked (+200 if Waterlogged) - the grip uses the Soak up - and it reels back 1 m. Little more than a hard slap on a dry target.
skills.verb_fit: Dry is "pull the water out of a body: damage by how wet it is": the damage is the water you take out.

good_modifiers.word: Wring and Throw: the dried body is flung back, not just staggered
Choking Grip: it reels back interrupted and Dazed
Wring and Heave: lifted off its feet and thrown 2 m
Hard Grip: more from the one body

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: Soaks the body as you wring it dry. Maths lets it act; it undoes the skill
a grip has nothing to pierce; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: damage_mult 1.6 -> 2.0, per Soak 90 -> 100: the bruiser's heavy payoff.

skills.name: Overboard
skills.summary: Grab one enemy within reach, lift it on a column of water and hurl it up to 6 m toward where you aim (heavy ones half as far; an elite only staggers). 40 when you grab it; where it lands, everyone within 1.5 m takes 40 and is knocked aside. Thrown into a wall, stone or another body, it is Crushed.
skills.verb_fit: Heave is "lift a body bodily and throw it": a grab, a lift and a throw, aimed by you.

new_mechanics.name: throw_target
new_mechanics.definition: displace mode: one enemy within range is lifted and thrown toward the aimed point, up to 'throw' m times its shove_resist (elites: staggered, not thrown). It travels as a shove, so meeting a wall, stone or body is a Crush; where it stops, 'on_land' hits every other enemy within its radius. Checked before essence is spent.

good_modifiers.word: Overboard and Away: thrown 1.5 m farther
Thrown Choking: it lands interrupted and Dazed
Breaking Heave: it lands like surf - a wider splash where it falls, more poise
Long Heave: a longer throw

bad_modifiers.why: drags back toward you the body you are throwing away. Maths lets it act; it should not
a throw has nothing that lasts; falls back to a little power
you throw it; nothing lands on you; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Drowning Hold
skills.summary: One enemy within 8 m: a ball of water closes over its head for 3 s. It is interrupted, cannot attack, cast, drum or call for help, and takes 20 at once and 15 a second. When the water lets go it heaves the enemy 3 m away from you, so put the wall behind it first.
skills.verb_fit: Drown is "water in the lungs: no casting, no calls for help, damage over time" - all three, on one body. For the bruiser it is the grapple: hold it under, then heave it into the wall.

good_modifiers.word: Long Hold: held under longer
Soaked Hold: it comes out Soaked, so the heave throws it half as far again
Reaching Hold: catch the drummer at the back

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: lifted out and thrown while it is held under. Maths lets it act; it should not
nothing to get behind: the hold already ignores its guard; falls back to a little power
there is no wind-up to shorten; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Backwash
skills.summary: 6 s or three blows, whichever ends first: each melee hit on you is halved, and the water splashes off you - whoever threw the blow, and everyone else within 2 m of you, is shoved 3 m and Soaked.
skills.verb_fit: Splash is "burst outward on contact, spraying those near": the blow lands, and the water bursts off you onto everyone close.

good_modifiers.word: Heavy Backwash: the splash throws them much farther
Long Backwash: it stays up longer
Rolling Backwash: a wider splash
Choking Backwash: whoever is splashed is also interrupted and Dazed

bad_modifiers.why: nothing to get behind; the splash does no damage; falls back to a cost cut
a pull on a skill whose point is throwing attackers off you: it drags them back into reach. Maths lets it act; it should not
the same as Drain, harder. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Seepage
skills.summary: One enemy within 9 m: water soaks in under its guard for 0.6 s, then wells up behind it - 50 damage that ignores its shield and armour, and a 1.5 m tug toward you. For 4 s its shield and armour count for nothing, against anyone.
skills.verb_fit: Seep is "soak in slowly, getting behind shields and armour": slow to arrive, and it arrives behind the shield. The bruiser's answer to the Pavise: for 4 s the big one's guard counts for nothing.

good_modifiers.word: Saturating Seep: Soaked through as well
Drawing Seep: the tug becomes a real drag out of the shield line
Quick Seep: wells up sooner
Lasting Seep: the guard stays open longer

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: bursting outward on contact is exactly what seeping in is not. Maths lets it act
nothing travels; no speed to raise, falls back to a little power
no poise to raise and nothing to knock down; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Sluice Step
skills.summary: You roll forward about 6.5 m as a wave. Every enemy you meet takes 30, is Soaked and is carried 3 m on ahead of you, the way you are going; one carried into a wall, stone or another body is Crushed.
skills.verb_fit: Wave is "a rolling wall of water": you are the wall, and it takes them with it. Re-anchored from Sweep (dropped): carrying things along now lives in Wave, and the dash got the weight of a bull rush.

good_modifiers.word: Breaking Wave: the bodies you carry are thrown on much farther - drive a line of them into the far wall
Choking Wave: everyone you roll through comes out interrupted and Dazed
a quicker roll
Wide Wave: a broader wall, catching the ones at the edge

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: what the wave carries sinks the moment it is picked up - Mired mid-carry. Maths lets it act; it should not
a dash lasts 0.28 s and leaves nothing; falls back to a little power
drags back toward you the bodies it is carrying away. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.change_note: base rune Sweep (WAT-6a, dropped) -> Wave (WAT-8a); 4.7 m -> 6.7 m, carries 3 m (was 2), +30 damage and 15 poise on each body; takes Tidal Bore's carry-to-the-wall. shove_dir 'along' is built.

skills.name: Siltfall
skills.summary: Everything you moved settles. Every enemy within 10 m that a water skill shoved or dragged in the last 1.5 s hits the floor where it now stands: 40 damage, Pinned (60% slower) for 2 s and 30 poise. Bodies still sliding finish their slide first.
skills.verb_fit: Settle is "the water goes still, and what it carries sinks and stays": it acts only on what your water has carried. Wave carries them to the wall; Settle drops them there for the next blow.

good_modifiers.word: Sinking Silt: they go under as they settle - interrupted and Dazed
Heavy Silt: knocked down harder, more poise
Wide Silt: reaches what you threw farthest

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a rolling wall that carries them on the moment they settle. Maths lets it act; it should not
lifts and throws the bodies it is sinking. Maths lets it act; it should not
a settling has no guard to get behind; falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: +40 damage: they hit the floor. Opposite is now Wave (Sweep dropped).

skills.name: Water Bolt
skills.dropped_why: A cheap ranged bolt is a caster's tool. Water's ranged starter is now Riptide Lash, the bruiser's way to reach a runner (a pull, as the brief allows); Surge's second skill is Cataract, the heavy hit. Its soak-and-knock lives on in Drench and Breaker.

skills.name: Undertow
skills.dropped_why: Area pull with no damage that gathers bodies at a point, not at your fists. Drawdown (every Soaked enemy dragged to you) and Riptide Lash cover Ebb's role for a bruiser; Ebb keeps one skill.

skills.name: Pressure Jet
skills.dropped_why: Its rune Gush is dropped. A held ranged stream is a caster's verb; its push-into-a-wall is Breaker's and Cataract's, and its pinned_mult is generalised as Cataract's against_wall_mult.

skills.name: Upwelling
skills.dropped_why: Its rune Float is re-meant as Heave (lift and throw one body). An area lift for 30 damage is control; Overboard takes the rune.

skills.name: Steady Drip
skills.dropped_why: Its rune Drip is dropped (Gush and Drip go as a pair). Slow poise wear from 10 m is not a bruiser's; Cataract's 60 poise and Breaker's 30 do the staggering up close.

skills.name: Tidal Bore
skills.dropped_why: A 20-essence rolling wall that overlapped Breaker, and its carry was never built. Wave's carry-to-the-wall moves into Sluice Step, where the wave is you.

skills.name: Slack Water
skills.dropped_why: Its rune Slack is dropped. The still moment at the turn of the tide is Ice's ground now: Ice's Stasis rune and Dead Calm, which leaves its target Stilled (this skill's status, kept in statuses.json for Ice).
